# iCE40 toolchain for the CI `fpga` job, installed with pip (YoWASP).
#
# The Ubuntu 24.04 toolchain is NOT used on purpose: distro nextpnr 0.6 does
# not close the 16 MHz constraint, while these wheels carry the yosys/nextpnr
# the design is calibrated against (870/1280 LCs at 25.45 MHz).  Versions are
# pinned for reproducibility; bump them deliberately when a new release is
# known to still fit.
#
# Used by actions/setup-python as the cache key (cache: pip).  These wheels are
# ~85 MB, so the cache saves a noticeable amount of time per run.
yowasp-yosys==0.69.0.0.post1233
yowasp-nextpnr-ice40==0.11.1.0.post826
